[G5]  [Ab5]

[Verse 1]
[G5]Ee
Oi
Sleep with one eye open You
have no idea what I'm capable of Keep
[Ab5]claiming holier than thou My knife can
stab more holes than you can count
[G5]How dare you sleep where a
king once slept And
dry [Ab5]the tears of where his
queen has wept

[Chorus]
[Eb5]
[G5]Kill, Torture, Terrorize
Welcome to my Mind

[Verse 2]
[G5]Terror comes in many forms and to-
night I'm terror You're my whore For
now I'll leave you blind but still alive
So you can feel my presence stronger
This soil has cursed me,
my inner demon's thirsty
You've confirmed to me the
world isn't safe
My only worry in the
world is that you can
walk [Ab5]on your own two feet
[G5]'Cause when you feel that last
breath slip away I
won't [Ab5]get to see you fall
down to your knees
